steps.what: Determine supplementary employment, medical or school information needed to assist the client
Request supplementary information and track responses from authorised record holders
Check received records for client identity, relevance, completeness and source

tasks.design: Configure request templates and a status list in the {OTHER} case-record system, using the authorised secure sending channel rather than ordinary unprotected {EMAIL}. The worker chooses the information needed, captures the request, checks every send and verifies the returned records.
tasks.previous_blocker: Request preparation and chasing can repeat reference and recipient details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and request-status fields can reduce repeated coordination.
tasks.still_hard: Missing information, mismatched identities and deciding what is necessary to collect.
tasks.human_edge: The worker understands the case and challenges irrelevant or inconsistent information.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive request administration, with unchanged collection and assessment authority.

reach.task: Check whether an authorised document request has a response
reach.learn: Request identifiers and restricted information handling

evidence.claim: Native request templates and explicit status tracking may reduce repeat coordination; this is an E1 design, not a measured collection-time result from the digest's report-drafting cases.

assumptions: Boundary is focal worker collection effort. Record holders' preparation time and the client's participation remain unchanged and are outside the focal denominator.
Worker s1 produces client reference, needed document types/date ranges, purpose, permitted recipient and information-sharing basis. All selection and capture retain 30 hours.

Worker s2 enters verified destination, request ID, dates, permitted content and status; capture, sending review and manual chases retain 21 hours. No pre-existing structured permission flag is assumed.
External record holder produces the requested documents through its usual response process; no new portal or extra formatting work is imposed. Worker s3 retains all source and identity checking.
Test native secure request features first. Missing contact, authority or a response blocks sending or triggers manual checking; automatic repeated chases are not introduced.
research_questions: Do checked templates reduce request effort after capture, chases and received-document review are included?

already_counted.description: Capture request fields, check sending details and handle chases

incremental.description: Maintain request templates and destination checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact request ID, client reference, destination, purpose, document scope, sharing basis and message checked before each send; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=30+21+40=91. Gross 9 less 1 upkeep gives net 8. Low assumes good existing templates or mostly difficult chases; high requires the stated 30-hour repetitive request slice. Information selection and verification do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess and agree an authorised placement in foster or adoptive homes or care institutions
Place children through coordinated family, home, institution or treatment-centre arrangements

tasks.design: Keep placement assessment, agreement and transition coordination with authorised people. Existing permitted records in the {OTHER} case-record system support them without automatic matching, eligibility decisions or new placement authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: A placement depends on the child's needs, current circumstances and accountable decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is proposed to replace this boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Suitability, continuity and the child's experience of transition.
tasks.human_edge: The worker hears the child, checks real conditions and coordinates with receiving people.
tasks.altitude: Placement responsibilities and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Confirm practical transition contacts after an authorised placement decision

evidence.claim: Placement judgement and transition work remain human; documentation-tool capability does not establish a saving for this task.

assumptions: Boundary is focal worker placement assessment and coordination, not the authority's legal decision, provider care or separate case-note writing.
Worker and relevant authorised participants produce placement arrangements through assessment and discussion. No structured suitability score or automatic placement trigger is assumed.
Receiving provider confirms current arrangements directly through the existing process; its effort is unchanged and outside focal hours.
Existing native case access remains as today; no build, additional capture or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
research_questions: Where do handovers fail to convey practical transition arrangements clearly?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=60+40=100; incremental=0. Both assessment and placement coordination retain their human time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend foster care and advise parents

steps.what: Recommend temporary foster care and advise foster or adoptive parents

tasks.design: Retain the foster-care recommendation and parent advice with the social worker within their authority. Existing case context in the {OTHER} case-record system informs a human discussion; no generated recommendation is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The recommendation depends on contextual child welfare judgement and trust.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change replaces the professional discussion in this design.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining difficult choices and responding to evolving family circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: The worker hears concerns, explains uncertainty and takes responsibility for advice.
tasks.altitude: Advice and recommendation responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify specialist support needed by a foster or adoptive family
reach.learn: Referral boundaries and family support options

evidence.claim: Foster-care recommendations and parent advice are retained human work; no contact-time saving is inferred from report-drafting tools.

assumptions: Boundary is recommendation and advice, not a final placement decision or separately assigned documentation. Overlap with placement assessment must be allocated once in a roll-up.
Worker obtains context through existing case material and direct discussion. No structured foster-care suitability flag is assumed.
Native case access remains sufficient. No new capture, recording or upkeep is proposed, so incremental work is zero.
research_questions: Do parents understand the limits and next steps of the recommendation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and incremental=0. Routine advice and contested recommendations both retain professional contact time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel students and arrange support services

steps.what: Counsel students and assess problems indicated by behaviour, progress or impairment
Find current service information for the agreed student support requirements
Arrange needed services with the student and authorised service contacts

tasks.design: Keep counselling and professional assessment human. Configure a current approved service directory in the {DOCS} for factual lookup; the worker checks options and arranges services with the student and authorised contacts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current contacts and service scope can require repeated searching.
tasks.enabler_now: A maintained indexed directory can reduce that factual search.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding need and checking whether a service can actually accept the student.
tasks.human_edge: The worker builds trust and checks that support is appropriate and understood.
tasks.altitude: A small reduction in directory searching; counselling and service decisions remain unchanged.

reach.task: Confirm which school support contact handles an agreed need
reach.learn: Local service scope and referral boundaries

evidence.claim: An indexed approved service directory can assist factual lookup without generating a needs assessment or eligibility decision. The small saving is an E1 scenario.

assumptions: Boundary covers counselling, factual service lookup and arrangement, not separately assigned referral-packet writing. Assessment stays within the worker's professional scope; the O*NET wording grants no medical diagnostic authority.
Worker s1 produces agreed support requirements through counselling. In s2 the worker selects service category, area, age range and access needs and checks source freshness within retained 6 hours.

Existing directory owner supplies service name, scope, contact, area, age range and last-checked date through ordinary maintenance. New indexing checks are covered by focal upkeep; no new external data collection is assumed.
Missing or stale entries require manual checking with contacts. Native directory filters are tested first; no model or automatic service referral is used.
Service provider confirms actual access in s3; capacity is not inferred from a directory entry. Its normal response effort is unchanged.
research_questions: Does indexed lookup save time after current service contacts and access are checked?

already_counted.description: Select filters, check currency and resolve directory gaps

incremental.description: Maintain directory links and indexing checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=80+6+10=96. Gross 4 less 1 upkeep gives net 3. Low assumes current easy lookup or stale directory data; high requires a 10-hour search slice. Counselling, assessment and service arrangement keep all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain placement, counselling and advice judgement while reducing selected request and directory administration.
reach: Clarify school support contacts with a school counsellor
Check authorised request status with a social service assistant
skills_to_grow: Keep factual lookup separate from professional assessment
role.ambitious_version: Use traceable requests and current service information to support child and family work without automating placement or care decisions.
